title.zh: Anthropic递交IPO当天遭美国政府上诉，Claude封禁已波及商业客户
title.en: Anthropic递交IPO当天遭美国政府上诉，Claude封禁已波及商业客户

current_state.zh: The US Justice Department appealed to the Ninth Circuit to restore a federal ban on Anthropic's Claude, filed the same day Anthropic submitted its IPO prospectus, with the dispute already costing commercial contracts including three deals worth over $180 million.
current_state.en: The US Justice Department appealed to the Ninth Circuit to restore a federal ban on Anthropic's Claude, filed the same day Anthropic submitted its IPO prospectus, with the dispute already costing commercial contracts including three deals worth over $180 million.
